selection.reason: Gemini 3.1 and Tripo 3.1 were recommended as available without a plan upgrade. Tripo produces character-suitable textured polygon meshes with face-count controls. Only its 3D schema was inspected: it was the clear current-plan choice over the equally priced older Tripo 3.0.

workflow.direction: Use the same approved identity reference for four separate style prompts. Each image must show one full-body Pak Mat, preserving his moustache, songkok, orange batik, green sarong and sandals. Reconstruct each approved style image separately, then import and render the resulting meshes in Blender.
workflow.reference_status: No approved reference asset ID supplied in this discovery request.

estimated_catalog_costs.qualification: Catalog baselines, not quotes for the recommended settings. References, image resolution, image quality, geometry, texture and topology settings can change costs. No model_run or dry_run was called. Blender rendering costs are excluded.

usage_and_plan.note: Availability comes from scoped recommend responses. Usage reports consumption, not available credit or guaranteed execution entitlement.

model_schemas.notation: Exact parameter names, types, defaults and declared constraints; descriptions condensed. Fields without required:true are optional. File inputs require real Scenario asset IDs, not paths or URLs.

required_bindings.prompt: One distinct style brief with explicit identity preservation, full-body framing, separated limbs and a plain background.
required_bindings.referenceImages: Array containing the actual approved identity-reference asset ID.

restrictions: referenceImages and video are mutually exclusive.
Pass referenceImages as an array even for one image; a bare value is ignored.
No seed, mask or negative-prompt field is exposed.
Reference image byte and pixel caps are not declared in this schema.

required_bindings.prompt: One distinct style brief preserving Pak Mat's identity and clothing.
required_bindings.referenceImages: Array containing the actual approved identity-reference asset ID.

restrictions: Requires Starter plan upgrade before execution.
If mask is provided, referenceImages is required.
Mask must be a PNG with transparency: transparent areas are edited; opaque areas are preserved.
Reference image byte and pixel caps are not declared in this schema.

model_tripo-v3-1-image-to-3d.recommendation_reason: Textured stylized meshes at a manageable face count. pbr:false allows explicit texture controls; delight:true removes baked lighting for Blender illumination.

required_bindings.image: The real asset ID of one approved single-subject style image.

restrictions: pbr:true causes texture parameters to be ignored.
Without smartLowPoly: maximum 1500000 faces for standard geometry or 2000000 for detailed geometry.
quad:true without smartLowPoly caps faceLimit at 150000 and outputs FBX.
With both smartLowPoly and quad enabled, omitted faceLimit defaults to 10000.
generateParts is incompatible with texture, pbr and quad.
Fast texture quality and delight use texture version v3.5 automatically.
No prompt, numOutputs, rigging or general output-format parameter is exposed.
A humanoid mesh is not a verified animation-ready rig; inspect geometry and materials in Blender.

tool_input_schemas.notation: Input declarations only; these tools were not executed. Both scope IDs must be supplied despite being optional in the generic declarations.

constraints: Supply exactly one of file_size or data.
file_size is the exact byte count and selects presigned multipart upload.
Inline data is base64, limited to approximately 100KB.
For multipart uploads, PUT raw bytes to every returned part URL and verify success before completion.
Use the upload_id returned by upload_asset.
No parts list or ETags argument exists.
Write-class tool; not called during this read-only discovery.
Omit format to download the original 3D file.
format converts images; it does not convert meshes to GLB or FBX.
Follow redirects when downloading the returned URL.

model_run.status: Schema inspected only; execution remains pending authorization and real input assets.

recommend_next_step.general_rule: If a subsequent recommend response returns ask_user, present its exact question and options and wait before model_run. proceed does not override pending project-write confirmation.
